content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I'm trying to add a new device to a project. My device matches [article_no], but the options I see are [article_no] or [article_no]. In [product_name] version [version_no], when I go online my device appears with the correct IP address, but there's a '?' symbol next to it. How can I select the correct device for my project?
I think you actually have the [product_name] [version_no]. The order number ends with [article_no]. In the device selection menu, look for [product_name] [version_no].
You're absolutely correct! Thank you so much! Why do they use different naming for the same thing?

It's the third generation in the [product_name] [version_no] series. [company_name] has changed the order number, which leads to confusion for many users. Why? I'm not sure... Only [company_name] knows.
I've noticed similar issues in other PLC series. It's always useful to double-check datasheets. I think it might be related to changes in electronic components and manufacturing processes.

analysis.insight_summary: Users struggled to add a device labeled with a specific article number in [product_name] software due to inconsistencies in naming conventions between hardware and software. The lack of clear alignment in product and version names made it difficult for users to confidently identify and configure their devices, resulting in confusion and hesitation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that device names or versions should be clearly listed in the software, matching exactly with their hardware, so they can easily recognize and configure their devices without ambiguity.
